quickSummary: Plants exhibit Haplontic (zygotic meiosis), Diplontic (gametic meiosis), or Haplodiplontic (sporic meiosis) cycles. High-yield exceptions: Fucus is Diplontic; Ectocarpus, Polysiphonia, and Kelps are Haplodiplontic.

summaryBox.title: Quick Section Summary
summaryBox.takeaway: All embryophytes alternate between n gametophyte and 2n sporophyte phases. Watch out for algal life cycle exceptions on the NEST exam.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
TYPES OF PLANT LIFE CYCLES
                                   │
      ┌────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────┐
      ▼                            ▼                            ▼
  HAPLONTIC                    DIPLONTIC                 HAPLODIPLONTIC
 (Gametophyte Dominant)       (Sporophyte Dominant)     (Alternating Phases)
  ├── Zygotic Meiosis          ├── Gametic Meiosis       ├── Gametophyte Dominant: Bryophytes
  └── Volvox, Spirogyra        └── Fucus, Seed Plants   └── Sporophyte Dominant: Pteridophytes
conceptBreakdown.content: All embryophytes exhibit **Alternation of Generations**: an alternation between a haploid gamete-producing phase (Gametophyte, $n$) and a diploid spore-producing phase (Sporophyte, $2n$).

conceptBreakdown.heading: 9.1 Summary Matrix of Plant Life Cycles
conceptBreakdown.title: 9.1 Summary Matrix of Plant Life Cycles
conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
ALGAL LIFE CYCLE EXCEPTIONS
                       
    Standard Algae (Spirogyra/Volvox)  ──► HAPLONTIC Life Cycle
    Fucus (Brown Alga)                ──► DIPLONTIC Life Cycle
    Ectocarpus / Polysiphonia / Kelps ──► HAPLODIPLONTIC Life Cycle
conceptBreakdown.content:
| Life Cycle Type | Dominant Phase | Dependent Phase | Meiotic Stage | Key Examples & Exceptions |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Haplontic** | Haploid Gametophyte ($n$) | Diploid Zygote ($2n$) only | **Zygotic Meiosis** (Zygote divides by meiosis immediately after syngamy) | *Volvox*, *Spirogyra*, *Chlamydomonas* |
| **Diplontic** | Diploid Sporophyte ($2n$) | Single-celled or reduced Gametes ($n$) | **Gametic Meiosis** (Meiosis occurs during gametogenesis) | All Gymnosperms, Angiosperms, AND ***Fucus*** (Brown Alga - **CRITICAL EXCEPTION!**) |
| **Haplodiplontic** | Equal or co-dominant alternating multicellular $n$ and $2n$ phases | Varies by division | **Sporic Meiosis** (Meiosis occurs during sporogenesis inside sporangia) | Bryophytes, Pteridophytes, AND ***Ectocarpus*, *Polysiphonia*, Kelps** (**CRITICAL ALGAL EXCEPTIONS!**) |
